channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ajay Mitchell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ajay Mitchell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Mark Daigneault on Ajay Mitchell:

“He put a great summer in. He got himself healthy, obviously, after ending the season injured. His body looks great. His game looks tight. He’s another guy who kind of knows who he is. He’s really caught up to the pitching of the NBA. He looks great.”

Mark Daigneault on Ajay Mitchell, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Chandler Parsons on Chet Holmgren:

“I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama. I really do. I don't think it is like Space Jam, but I don't think he can take two shots in Game 7. You don't play 33 minutes and take two shots. I would rather live and die with going down with Ajay Mitchell out and Jalen Williams out. I would rather have him be 0 for 15 than one for two.”

Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell, Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell confronting Ajay Mitchell after the hard foul that sent the Spurs guard sprawling onto the court:

“We're a pretty close group and brothers (do) that. It's in our nature to just stand up for each other. But we have to move on and keep our composure throughout the game.”

Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell, Ajay Mitchell, May 23, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:SGA on Ajay Mitchell:

“It's been amazing. You could say he's been our best player this series... It's all coming together before the world's eyes.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Ajay Mitchell, May 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Chet Holmgren on Ajay Mitchell:

“I think it's a crime that he fell where he did in the draft. I'm sure some jobs were lost for that one.”

Chet Holmgren on Ajay Mitchell, Apr 25, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Dillon Jones, Nikola Topic, Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Topic, Jones and Mitchell:

“These are three guys we have great confidence in. We’re really excited about them.”

Mark Daigneault on Dillon Jones, Nikola Topic, Ajay Mitchell, Jun 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
